method: sRGB → CMYK → sRGB; relative colorimetric; black-point compensation; no paper-white simulation
scope: Refined flirty set, both sides. Screen comparison only; not production artwork.

adjusted_variant.method: Change brand-color CMYK separations before converting back to sRGB; interpolate changes through existing antialiased edges and watermark blends. Plum and cream retain the automatic conversion.
adjusted_variant.note: Exploratory process-color palette. Applies to both supplied logo and layout colors. Not UPS-approved or a fluorescent-ink simulation.
